name: Delegation
description: Coding agents hand tasks to each other: Claude Code asks Codex for a second opinion, or starts a few sessions on parallel work, and waits for their answers or carries on. Each subagent is its own thread in the inbox, shown with the session that started it; it never gets more permissions than that one, and what it asks permission for comes to you.
forAgents: Another coding agent as your subagent (a second opinion from Codex, a parallel task): `delegate.start`.

agents_answer.label: Agents answer their subagents
agents_answer.description: an agent may answer the questions its subagents ask (never their permissions, which only you answer); off, those questions wait for you in the inbox
